decisions.reason: This lever handle family sits squarely in the firm's core design and fitting know-how, so the firm can readily read market feedback and refine it, and families are typically kept as long-lived catalogue lines.

This handle design builds on the firm's established knowledge base and was still listed in 2019, but individual designs rotate more often than families, so it carries a moderate risk of being phased out.

The electronic access system with patented light technology was upgraded to a Pro version in 2019, which shows the firm is absorbing learning and developing it in-house in line with its strategic push toward digital building organization.
